title: a gazetteer's candidate verifies its name only in full
line: the owner's string for the Schwenkfelders' home village writes Harperdorf; GOV's one candidate is Nieder Harpersdorf, today Twardocice, a letter apart: a close spelling of the name is offered on the card and verifies nothing, as a close spelling of any other part of a string does

steps.say: the owner's string, as the export writes it
the resolver run with the geocoder's, GOV's and Wikidata's real answers planted in their caches

expect.why: no candidate verifies on every part
GOV's Nieder Harpersdorf is a letter from the string's name: near, offered for the owner to read, never verified
